known_launch_lines: sim) exec ros2 launch limo_sim_bringup sim.launch.py world:="$PWD/worlds/smoke_maze.world" headless:=true spawn_artifacts:="$run_dir/spawn" ;;

navigation) exec ros2 launch limo_maze_bringup mapping_navigation.launch.py map_epoch:="$(cat "$run_dir/epoch.txt")" nav_params:="$run_dir/nav2-rpp-03m.yaml" slam_params:="$PWD/src/limo_maze_bringup/config/slam_smoke_experimental.yaml" ;;

perception) exec ros2 run limo_maze_perception red_rgbd_detector --ros-args -p use_sim_time:=true -p enabled:=true -p depth_registered_to_color:=true -p publish_frame_processing:=true -p retention_enabled:=true -p retention_output_dir:="$run_dir/retained" -p retention_max_jobs:=96 -p retention_max_file_bytes:=268435456 ;;

mission) exec ros2 run limo_maze_mission mission --ros-args -p use_sim_time:=true -p autonomous:=true -p tf_max_age_s:=1.5 -p navigation_failure_cooldown_s:=1.0 -p navigation_recovery_timeout_s:=3.0 -p frontier_fallback_standoff_m:=0.8 -p require_processed_inspection:=true -p require_retained_inspection:=true -p retention_max_total_samples:=96 -p retention_max_metadata_bytes:=4194304 -p post_mapping_observation_mode:=bounded_processed_frames -p observation_max_stations:=3 -p observation_headings_per_station:=4 -p observation_max_dispatches:=12 -p observation_stage_timeout_s:=360.0 -p observation_relocation_radius_m:=0.15 -p initial_clearance_radius_m:=0.30 -p initial_clearance_source:=smoke_world_sha256_1ef2017583d448e36fb35825bbef6735536c2fe3cbf3a7a57380cf365c708811 -p mission_timeout_s:=900.0 -p return_timeout_s:=240.0 -p goal_timeout_s:=120.0 -p output_dir:="$run_dir/mission" ;;

process_inventory.selection: Exact LIMO_RUN34_ID token, verified recorded leader PID/start_ticks, or exact known project path in an argument. No unrelated argv/environment is retained.

limitations: Static configuration hashes do not establish effective ROS parameters; collect parameter dumps separately.
Collector module imports identify resolution under its current environment, not Python module files introspected inside an already running process.
File hashes describe files at capture time, not independently attested startup bytes.
Library records require /proc maps membership; on-disk file identity and stability are reported separately.
Processes can start or exit during this non-atomic snapshot; missing live libraries are not proof that a component never ran.
Project-path matches without the run token or validated PID/start_ticks remain explicitly unverified for run34 ownership.
No detector quality, visual coverage or whole-mission success is inferred.

expected.tf_stamp_policy: Unchanged ROS scan stamp plus transform_timeout; restamp_tf=false.
expected.scheduling_change: Relative to run32, only map publication scheduling changes Rate to WallRate; steady TF and scan-derived header semantics remain.

slam_overlay_gate.scope: Actual owned process /proc/maps path, SHA, inode/device and stable PID; package prefix alone is insufficient. Snapshot after mission startup, not before the first goal.
